context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 111 tested 3 new features: (1) Executive Dashboard skeleton/empty state - shows 4 KPI card placeholders + 2 chart areas with pulse animation during loading, shows error state with Upload Data CTA when API fails; (2) Approval Workflow page at /approvals - shows pipeline overview with 7 stages (Draft, Submitted, Category Approved, Senior Approved, Head Approved, Ordered, Rejected), plan cards with status badges and role-gated action buttons, history toggle for approval timeline; (3) Notification polling stability - NotificationBell pauses polling when tab is hidden using document.visibilitychange. All tests passed. The approval workflow has 31 plans across various statuses.
